title: TPG Partners V & Silver Lake Partners II - proposed acquisition of Sabre Holdings Corporation

body_sections.Summary: TPG Partners V & Silver Lake Partners II  propose to jointly acquire Sabre Holdings Corporation.
body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC considered the Proposed Acquisition in the context of: - the national market for the supply of GDS and related services; - the national market for the supply of CRS and related services; and - the national market for the supply of online travel services.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The Proposed Acquisition represents a mere transfer of ownership and is therefore likely to have a minimal impact on the existing level of competition in the relevant markets.  Further, issues of vertical integration do not appear to raise concerns because Tiger Airways is a minor participant in Australia's aviation industry. Accordingly, on 11 January 2006, the ACCC formed the view that the proposed acquisition is unlikely to substantially lessen competition in the relevant markets.
